title: Urbanization, geographic accessibility, and delayed entry into tuberculosis-designated care in southwestern China: a machine-learning prediction study
summary: A LightGBM prediction model using 60,778 tuberculosis surveillance records found delayed entry to TB-designated care common and identified geographic accessibility measures among leading predictors; it reports a held-out test cohort and calls for external validation. The result is reported in the Research Square preprint. Affiliation was not stated in the reviewed material. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
